    # Explicit demand satisfaction: inflow into a demand city >= its demand
    def demand_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return inflow >= d["demand"][k]

    model.demand_sat = pyo.Constraint(model.CITIES, rule=demand_rule)

    def link_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= d["link_cap"][(i, j)]

    model.link_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.ARCS, rule=link_rule)

    # City capacity: total inflow into k <= city capacity
    def city_rule(m, k):
        return sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k) <= d["city_cap"][k]

    model.city_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.CITIES, rule=city_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = list(d["cost"].keys())

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets -------------------------------------------------------------
    model.CITIES = pyo.Set(initialize=cities, ordered=True)
    model.ARCS = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2)

    # --- Variables: x[i,j] units shipped i->j, 0 <= x <= link capacity ----
    def x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["link_cap"][(i, j)])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.ARCS, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=x_bounds)

    # --- Objective: minimize total transportation cost --------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["cost"][(i, j)] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # --- Flow balance: inflow - outflow = -net  (net = supply - demand) ---
    # Decision (item 3): signed per A; City 0 with supply +4 exports, i.e. its
    # inflow - outflow = -4. Demand nodes import exactly their demand, so this
    # equality also satisfies the "demand must be met" requirement (item 4).
    def balance_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        outflow = sum(m.x[k, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        return inflow - outflow == -d["net"][k]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.CITIES, rule=balance_rule)

    # --- Link capacity rows: explicit per-pair limit ----------------------
    def link_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= d["link_cap"][(i, j)]

    model.link_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.ARCS, rule=link_rule)

    # --- City capacity: total inflow into k <= city capacity --------------
    def city_rule(m, k):
        return sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k) <= d["city_cap"][k]

    model.city_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.CITIES, rule=city_rule)

    return model
